text: The access model is demonstrated and signed off. Now it needs to survive without anyone standing next to it -- that takes three separate documents.
A classification reference naming which columns are phi and why, a plain-English access policy with no SQL, and a lineage description written as prose, not a diagram.
patient_name and patient_ssn are tagged phi directly on the table -- queryable by anyone with Catalog Explorer access, never dependent on a document staying in sync.
The lineage paragraph traces one claim from the clearinghouse file drop through Auto Loader, the Lakeflow pipeline's expectations, silver, both gold tables, and the nightly Workflow, out to Power BI.
All three live where Compliance actually works, and a representative was walked through finding them live. Next: the honest ending.
